name: Sweet-and-sour horseshoe crab
summary: Sam xào chua ngọt is the horseshoe-crab plate VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, puts in Hạ Long, with chả sam and trứng sam named beside it. Cooks there kill the animals as a pair, one male and one female.
origin: Hạ Long. VnExpress, 16 Mar 2021, and Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition, 23 Jul 2021.
howToEat: VnExpress says cooks kill sam as a pair because people there say a single animal is more likely to cause an allergy and a cold stomach. The same article says sam is cold in nature. If you have had a seafood allergy or a stomachache from seafood, skip it.
The named plates are sweet-and-sour stir-fry, a cake, and the eggs. A recipe beyond those names was not printed.
VnExpress printed about 150,000 đồng a plate. Báo Quảng Ninh’s English edition says about the same and names chợ Hạ Long 1. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: The snack area of chợ Hạ Long 1.
seoTitle: Sam xao Ha Long — sweet-and-sour horseshoe crab
seoDescription: Sam in Hạ Long is stir-fried sweet-and-sour, made into a cake, or served as eggs, and cooks kill it in pairs. The 2021 plate was about 150,000 đồng. A current price is Check on arrival.
